description: Zero-code tracing, metrics and logs for .NET and .NET Framework apps on Windows Azure App Service. Installs the Splunk Distribution of OpenTelemetry .NET 1.16.0 (signalfx/splunk-otel-dotnet@v1.16.0), unmodified, and activates it through applicationHost.xdt; configure it with OTEL_* App Settings. Not an official Splunk product and not supported by Splunk; not affiliated with or endorsed by the OpenTelemetry project.
title: Kjt .NET Azure App Services Extension for OpenTelemetry, for use with the Splunk distribution
